title: Benchmarking Continuous Time Models for Predicting Multiple Sclerosis Progression
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper benchmarks models for predicting Multiple Sclerosis progression, not anything related to faith or religion.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are unrelated to religion. It finds that Neural Controlled Differential Equations outperform the best discrete time model (TCN) in predicting Multiple Sclerosis progression on the MSOAC dataset.
